name: Valsolda (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valsolda (a tower topped by a heron on light blue) within branches, with the motto VALLIS SOLIDA on a scroll beneath.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 1 October 2020.

features.role: Valsolda arms — tower topped by a heron on light blue, crowned, within branches, with motto VALLIS SOLIDA
